secrets_policy: Real .env files are excluded from release packages; only .env.example is shipped.
release_fixes: v0.3.0: added Report Employee (Phase 2) — analyze_dataset Tool, report_service.py, report-employee system Employee seed, GET /files/{id}/download, report_artifacts carry-through on Run.output_data, and matching frontend UI. Zero new migrations.

v0.4.0: Phase 2 closed per user-reported real-environment test (2026-08-09). Added Phase 3 validation tooling — feedback table/API and admin Validation dashboard tracking the Roadmap's own >=3-active-tenant exit criterion. One new migration (b3c4d5e6f713); Phase 3 itself (real customer validation) is explicitly NOT claimed complete by this code release.

v0.5.0: added Document Employee (Phase 5) — analyze_document Tool, document_service.py (OCR eng+fas via Tesseract with native-PDF-text fast path, DOCX/TXT extraction, regex field detection, keyword document-type classification), document-employee system Employee seed, document_artifacts carry-through on Run.output_data, and matching frontend UI. Zero new migrations. Also fixed a pre-existing gap in the uploaded v0.4.2 package: test_v036_e2e_contract.py still asserted the Phase 3 Alembic head instead of the actual Phase 4 billing head. Started ahead of the Phase 4 commercial exit gate per 61_PHASE4_BASELINE_AUDIT_v0.4.1.md, at explicit user direction — see governance note in 63_PHASE_5_DOCUMENT_EMPLOYEE_AS_BUILT_v0.5.0.md.

v0.6.0: added a real Stripe payment-provider adapter (app/services/stripe_service.py) on top of the existing provider-neutral Phase 4 billing core — real Checkout Session creation, real Billing Portal session creation, and Stripe webhook signature verification + event translation. Closes the implementation half of the Phase 4 commercial exit gate identified in 61_PHASE4_BASELINE_AUDIT_v0.4.1.md; the commercial half (proven MRR + paid subscribers) remains open pending a live Stripe run outside this delivery environment, which has no network access to Stripe. Zero new migrations. Built at explicit user direction after being asked to choose between continuing the Employee sequence (Phase 6/Invoice Employee per the original Roadmap numbering) or closing this gate first — see governance/numbering notes in 64_PHASE_6_STRIPE_INTEGRATION_AS_BUILT_v0.6.0.md and 23_AS_BUILT_CURRENT_STATE_v0.6.0.md.

release_fixes.fix: backend/app/main.py FastAPI version kwarg and both health endpoints were stale at 0.4.2 since before v0.6.0; corrected to 0.6.1 across pyproject.toml, package.json, and main.py.
